evidence: We have grown nominally undoped ZnSe on GaAs from the precursors H2Se and Et2Zn. Replacement of Et2Zn by Zn[N(TMS)2]2 produced crystalline ZnSe of a lesser quality. Data indicate incorporation of nitrogen into the films when Et2Zn is utilized as the main zinc source with Zn[N(TMS)2]2 being introduced at dopant levels.
